physics_contract.pr104_tau_domain: Mean-volume redshift z=20 to z=4+, not total CMB optical depth
physics_contract.history_closure: ne_mean=Q*(nH_proper+nHe_proper); xe_per_H=(1+yHe)*Q; HII+HeII ionized phase and neutral complement
physics_contract.background_control: Same H(t), mean scale factor, ne, radiation inputs and cosmic-time boundaries; isotropized transport is a diagnostic, not asserted same-matter Einstein-FLRW
physics_contract.thomson: Homogeneous comoving cold-electron elastic limit; fixed-cosmic-time tau is direction independent; observed-redshift boundaries require directional mapping
physics_contract.signal_bands: B CMB/transport diagnostic spectrum and C ionizing-UV source are distinct; CMB moments are not H photoionization/heating suppliers
physics_contract.collisionless_claim: xe does not affect collisionless I
physics_contract.scenario_uncertainty: Scenario sensitivity is not a posterior or statistical interval
physics_contract.native_diagnostic: Threshold-cell signed step difference is not a global true error bound; stiff order reduction remains a hypothesis

new_fast_track_observable_budget.near_zero: Declare an absolute floor before pilot; report limits below resolution

numerical_policy.verification: Reuse unchanged evidence; add checks for changed code, inputs, interpolation and claims; bounded independent review of a new claim or algorithm
numerical_policy.long_run: Set a finite allocation and checkpoint before actual long science; no automatic native allocation renewal
numerical_policy.delivery: Milestone artifacts and selective publication acknowledgement; no full-archive restore prerequisite for ordinary plan or output changes

resource_policy.local_codex: Only for an observed missing runtime/data capability
resource_policy.ncp: Cost-measured parallel independent cases with explicit thread limits; no 64x assumption for one adaptive history
